name: Lombok and the Gili Islands
tagline: Turtles, volcano treks and car-free islands
summary: Lombok is Bali's quieter neighbour, with Mount Rinjani's crater lake, waterfalls and surf beaches in the south. Hop to the car-free Gili Islands to snorkel with turtles, cycle around Gili Trawangan and watch sunset from the swings.
seasonNote: May to September is dry; Rinjani closes in the wet season (January to March).
arrival: Lombok International Airport; fast boats from Bali to the Gilis take 2 hours.
gettingAround: Drivers and scooters on Lombok; bikes and horse carts on the Gilis.
cashTip: Carry rupiah in small notes for warungs, boats and island fees; ATMs are limited on the Gilis.
foodTip: Ayam taliwang (spicy grilled chicken) and plecing kangkung.
baseArea: Gili Trawangan, Kuta Lombok or Senggigi

connections.note: Fast boats from Padang Bai or Sanur.
